name: isEmpty
covering_tests: lodash methods :: should accept falsey arguments
lodash(...) methods that return unwrapped values :: `_(...).isEmpty` should return an unwrapped value when implicitly chaining
lodash.isEmpty :: should not treat objects with lengths larger than `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` as array-like
lodash.isEmpty :: should not treat objects with negative lengths as array-like
lodash.isEmpty :: should not treat objects with non-number lengths as array-like
lodash.isEmpty :: should return `false` for non-empty values
lodash.isEmpty :: should return `true` for empty values
lodash.isEmpty :: should return an unwrapped value when implicitly chaining
lodash.isEmpty :: should work with an object that has a `length` property
lodash.isEmpty :: should work with jQuery/MooTools DOM query collections
lodash.isEmpty :: should work with prototytpe objects
